units.titles: Insecure usage of abi.encodePacked for the signature verification
units.known_address_notes: Corpus chain label 'Solana' is wrong: the report covers MKLockRegistry.sol + MonkeyLegends.sol (Solidity, ERC721A) and links the deployed, Etherscan-verified contract. Address was wrapped across lines in the PDF ('…b407' + '83#code'); reassembled to 40 hex chars and confirmed by getCode + getsourcecode. Source repo 0xBURP/MonkeyKingdom-MonkeyLegends is now 404.

PeckShield 2023-128 (repo poop-finance/poop-contract, now 404). Project had no address in the corpus. BSC contract 'Poop' located via Dexscreener, then matched against the audit: audited referral logic lives in the token itself (buy/sell take an arbitrary referral parameter, PoopFeeSplitter splitter), which this verified contract implements. Single Poop token with meaningful liquidity on BSC; treated as the audited instance.

units.titles: Seller can set wrong type in _reserveInfo.remaining to stop buyer from payRemains and steal the collateral
units.known_address_notes: Verichains Oct-2022 (v1.2) review of the NF3Market marketplace (commit 1d7849d1…, repo NF3Labs/contracts-V2 — now 404). Report has no address/chain. Both mainnet NF3Market deployments were located by matching the audited payRemains/_reserveInfo code in the Polygon verified-source sanctuary; the older 0x98e7… build is the primary match for the audited version, 0x0435… is a later deployment of the same contract. Polygon Mumbai deployments also exist (testnet, not recorded).
